description: Range-restricted, operator-restricted right-hand sides (issue #540): operator selection by per-term provenance, tiles of a horizontal decomposition reading halo cells from an extended local array, and lanes over a run-time list of cells or columns. Every comparison is BITWISE against the same binding's whole-domain evaluation of the same selected program under the same compiler (native). Generated by scripts/gen-range-restricted-rhs-manifest.py.

scope_excluded.python: No native tile or lane implementation (API_SPEC §5.8, "Range-restricted right-hand sides"): rhs_program, select, halo, restrict and lanes raise compiler_unavailable, which pkg/earthsci-ast-py/tests/test_range_restricted_rhs.py asserts for the first case.

state.k: the 1-based column-major linear index of the element over the variable's full declared shape (1 for a 0-d state)

tolerance.rule: abs(sum_k G_k - F) <= rel * sum_k abs(G_k), elementwise
